method: Same AI, separate source-first pass after freezing. Started with the dated Economics scheme, its final-year choice rules and the 10 EC thesis entry. Rebuilt the credit and progression structure and checked the sources for accounting, banking, trade, microeconomics and empirical research. Reconsidered the current UCR workbook for each selected course and checked the exact finished comparison. Worker A performed both passes.
findings: The English-taught Economics and Business Economics BSc at Groningen, programme 50950, has 180 EC. Economics is selected for the generic target because it develops the shared economic theory, markets, policy and empirical core without selecting a firm or sustainability specialism. The dated scheme has twelve 5 EC courses in the common first year, twelve 5 EC courses in the selected second year, and an approved 30 EC minor plus 20 EC of profile courses and a 10 EC Economics thesis in year three. The internship is 15 EC and combines with three 5 EC Minor E&BE courses. At least three of the four named Economics courses are required; one can be replaced with a programme elective. This example takes all four and leaves the minor choice open. The public profile table presents additional thesis entries, including a 20 EC entry. The dated standard Economics scheme and EBB908B10 establish the applicable 10 EC thesis.

The common first year introduces mathematics, economics, accounting and statistics before data analysis and the introductory research project in block 2B. The second-year plan sequences monetary macroeconomics, growth, matrix methods and industrial organisation before econometrics and trade policy in block 2A, and the empirical paper in 2B. The empirical paper is supported by earlier econometrics. Banking builds on the finance, accounting and economic foundations. Year three allocates 30 EC to the minor in the first semester. Dynamic Macroeconomics and Labour Economics are in 2A, and Microeconomics – Choice & Strategy and History of Economic Thought in 2B. The thesis normally runs in semester two, with a semester-one offering also listed. Thesis entry requires 120 EC including all of year one and an approved plan. Prior econometrics and the empirical research paper are strongly recommended and completed earlier in the example.

The closest option combines economics, public policy, economic behaviour and market organisation with research, calculus, probability, numerical modelling and econometrics. Numerical methods supports model approximation and replaces the business AI applications course only in this option. Behavioural Economics remains substantive, with psychology and deviations from standard models, and its selected fall term follows introductory microeconomics. International Business & Governance adds trade theory and policy. Money, Banking & Finance offers a stronger counterpart to Economics of Banking than the investment course. The business option builds from venture and product foundations to strategy, leadership, law, marketing and finance, with accounting, market research and quantitative tools. Consumer Product Design is moved to its first-year offering. The international and sustainability option adds environmental science, sustainability governance, climate communication, environmental justice and a renewable-system design project to economics, trade and financial context. Earth Observation replaces an advanced sustainability project only available in the first term, supplying geospatial methods after Sustainability Essentials I and introductory data analysis. Description-only Behavioural Economics, Econometrics, Market Research, Strategy & Digital Transformation, Social Movements & Environmental Justice and Renewable System Design contribute the actual subject and methods supported by their descriptions. The formal microeconomics course aligns with UCR microeconomics rather than negotiation. Dutch economy, advanced dynamic macroeconomics, labour economics, economic thought, the minor and the required economics thesis remain distinct. The three examples each exceed the pairwise course difference floor and address the three evidenced degree profiles, with minors informing focus within those alternatives.
